root::BELLICUM_MILTENYI_Supply_Agreement.title: Miltenyi–Bellicum Master Supply Agreement
root::BELLICUM_MILTENYI_Supply_Agreement.summary: {{party-1|Miltenyi}} supplies cell-processing products to {{party-2|Bellicum}} for use in manufacturing cell-based therapies, under a non-exclusive, multi-year master contract with product-specific modules. {{party-2|Bellicum}} pays upfront and milestone fees, commits to minimum purchases, and receives a limited license; terms cover delivery, change control, and second sourcing.

parties.name: Miltenyi Biotec GmbH
parties.does: Supply cell-processing products, maintain quality, grant limited license, manage changes, and support second sourcing if needed.

parties.name: Bellicum Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
parties.does: Purchase products, pay fees and milestones, provide forecasts, meet minimum purchase, use products within license, and manage regulatory compliance.

root::SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.title: Affiliate Marketing Agreement between Equidata, Inc. and National Credit Report.com, LLC
root::SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.summary: This agreement allows {{party-2|National Credit Report.com, LLC}} to market and sell the personal credit and fraud detection services provided by {{party-1|Equidata, Inc.}}, under specified operational, compliance, and compensation terms, for an initial term of one year with automatic renewal unless terminated as outlined.

parties.name: Equidata, Inc.
parties.does: Provide credit-related services, invoice for services, approve marketing materials, and may audit affiliate's practices.

parties.name: National Credit Report.com, LLC
parties.does: Market and sell Equidata's services, collect payments from consumers, pay Equidata, comply with laws, and avoid soliciting Equidata's clients.
